description: Source code for the SensorDevice class in Android, managing sensor hardware interactions, sensor list initialization, activation, batching, and dynamic sensor handling.

classes.name: SensorDevice
classes.description: Main class managing sensor hardware, sensor list, activation, batching, dynamic sensors, and communication with hardware abstraction layer.

classes.name: SensorDevice::Info
classes.description: Inner class representing sensor activation info, batch parameters, and active client management.

methods.name: SensorDevice::SensorDevice
methods.description: Constructor initializing sensor list and connecting to HAL service.

methods.name: SensorDevice::~SensorDevice
methods.description: Destructor.

methods.name: SensorDevice::connectHalService
methods.description: Attempts to connect to sensor HAL via AIDL or HIDL wrappers.

methods.name: SensorDevice::initializeSensorList
methods.description: Retrieves sensor list from HAL, adjusts sensor parameters, and initializes internal data structures.

methods.name: SensorDevice::reactivateSensors
methods.description: Reactivates sensors based on previous activation states after HAL reconnection.

methods.name: SensorDevice::sensorHandlesChanged
methods.description: Checks if sensor handles or properties have changed between old and new sensor lists.

methods.name: SensorDevice::sensorIsEquivalent
methods.description: Compares two sensor_t structures for equivalence.

methods.name: SensorDevice::dump
methods.description: Outputs current sensor and activation status information.

methods.name: SensorDevice::getSensorList
methods.description: Returns pointer to sensor list and its size.

methods.name: SensorDevice::initCheck
methods.description: Checks if HAL wrapper is initialized.

methods.name: SensorDevice::poll
methods.description: Polls sensor events from HAL, processes dynamic sensor meta events.

methods.name: SensorDevice::onDynamicSensorsConnected
methods.description: Handles new dynamic sensors connection.

methods.name: SensorDevice::onDynamicSensorsDisconnected
methods.description: Handles dynamic sensors disconnection (not implemented).

methods.name: SensorDevice::writeWakeLockHandled
methods.description: Informs HAL that wake lock has been handled.

methods.name: SensorDevice::autoDisable
methods.description: Disables sensor for a specific client.

methods.name: SensorDevice::activate
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a sensor for a client.

methods.name: SensorDevice::batch
methods.description: Sets batch parameters for a sensor.

methods.name: SensorDevice::setDelay
methods.description: Sets delay (sampling period) for a sensor.

methods.name: SensorDevice::flush
methods.description: Flushes sensor data.

methods.name: SensorDevice::isClientDisabled
methods.description: Checks if a client is disabled.

methods.name: SensorDevice::isSensorActive
methods.description: Checks if a sensor is active.

methods.name: SensorDevice::onMicSensorAccessChanged
methods.description: Handles microphone sensor access change.

methods.name: SensorDevice::enableAllSensors
methods.description: Re-enables all sensors.

methods.name: SensorDevice::disableAllSensors
methods.description: Disables all sensors.

methods.name: SensorDevice::injectSensorData
methods.description: Injects sensor data for testing.

methods.name: SensorDevice::setMode
methods.description: Sets sensor operation mode.

methods.name: SensorDevice::registerDirectChannel
methods.description: Registers a direct memory channel for sensors.

methods.name: SensorDevice::unregisterDirectChannel
methods.description: Unregisters a direct memory channel.

methods.name: SensorDevice::configureDirectChannel
methods.description: Configures a direct memory channel.
